customer_updates.name: Om Sakhare
customer_updates.text:
I recently visited MelodyBooth Recording Studio, and my experience was nothing short of amazing. From the moment I walked in, the ambiance was welcoming, and the positive vibes made me feel right at home. The studio itself is well-equipped, with a professional setup that ensures high-quality results.

Harmesh Vanmali, the studio owner, was an absolute pleasure to work with. He’s humble, kind, and genuinely passionate about what he does. We had a great conversation, and his expertise made the entire process smooth and enjoyable. The recording session was quick and efficient, and the final mastered audio for my YouTube video turned out fantastic—clear, crisp, and perfectly polished.

What stood out to me was the personal touch Harmesh brings to his work. He takes the time to understand your needs and delivers results that exceed expectations. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned creator, MelodyBooth is the place to go for a professional yet friendly recording experience. I highly recommend this studio to anyone looking for quality work in a comfortable and inspiring environment.

featured_reviews.name: Bharat Ahire
featured_reviews.review_text: Had great experience at MelodyBooth Recording Studio, while recording one Bollywood cover song. Amazing ambience with positive vibes. I would like to thank Harmesh Vanmali ( owner of the studio) who himself is the great singer, composer and sound engineer helped me a lot during recording session. Tips he shared enhanced my singing. It was my first ever studio recording and i was little nervous, but trust me i felt confident as soon as went in recording area :) I would suggest to all reading this review, to visit this studio for Cover/ original songs recording, voice over, etc.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Harmesh, who is the owner of this studio is very talented. This is the place where creativity and professionalism lives under one roof. This isn’t just a recording space — it’s a complete musical hub where songwriting, production, recording, mixing, and creative collaboration all come together seamlessly.
Harmesh brings not only deep technical knowledge but also a genuine passion for music. He has an incredible ear for detail and knows exactly how to guide artists to bring out their best performance. Whether you’re a beginner finding your sound or an experienced artist refining a project, he creates an environment that feels both inspiring and comfortable.

featured_reviews.name: Jitesh Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Studio and Engineer.

Working at this music studio has been an amazing experience from start to finish. The environment is professional, comfortable, and fully equipped, making it easy to focus and get creative. Every session felt smooth and inspiring, and the studio’s overall vibe really helped bring out the best in my music.

What truly makes this place stand out is the engineer. His ear for detail, patience, and guidance helped elevate my sound in ways I couldn’t have achieved alone. He offered direction when I needed it, pushed me to refine my ideas, and made sure every track reached its full potential. I’m genuinely grateful for his dedication and expertise, and I’ll definitely be returning for future projects.

I had a truly exceptional experience at Dora Photo Studio, and I feel compelled to share it because service like this is rare.

From the very beginning, he guided me patiently over the phone, helping me reach the studio from my home without any confusion. When I arrived, the studio itself immediately stood out — it was clean, well-decorated, and maintained a very professional atmosphere.

What impressed me most was his hospitality and genuine care. He respectfully asked me to sit, offered me water, and made me feel completely comfortable. When I mentioned facing difficulty getting an auto, he didn’t hesitate to help — he personally booked a Rapido ride and ensured I got home safely.

The quality of work was equally commendable. He edited my daughter’s passport photos beautifully with great attention to detail. Even my own passport-size photo turned out perfectly. You can clearly see the dedication and skill in his work.

Beyond the service, what truly made this experience memorable was his humility and kindness. He even walked with me to the auto and made sure I was safely on my way. Our conversation was genuine and heartfelt, which is something you don’t often find in business interactions today.

This is not just a photo studio — it is a place where professionalism meets humanity. Highly recommended for anyone looking not just for good photos, but for a truly respectful and caring experience.
